links.outcome: Rate at which chatbot refused/deferred to physician on obesity management questions
links.effect: Google Gemini refused 2 of 10 questions and insisted on consulting a physician; Microsoft Copilot answered all 10.
links.quote: Google Gemini refused to respond to two questions and insisted on consulting a physician.

links.outcome: Appropriateness and completeness of chatbot obesity treatment answers versus ADA/AACE guidelines
links.effect: All Copilot and 8/10 Gemini responses appropriate; none inappropriate. Copilot complete 10/10 versus Gemini 5/10.
links.quote: Microsoft Copilot (10/10; 100%) provided a higher proportion of complete responses than Google Gemini (5/10; 50%).

screen.reason: Evaluated public LLM chatbots (Google Gemini and Microsoft Copilot) on responses to obesity management questions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
